Title: Two Students of the Fist
Body: An orphan named Ryu and a rich American kid named Ken Masters grow up as brothers under Gouken, a master of Ansatsuken - the 'assassin's fist'. Gouken teaches them the art without its killing intent: the Hadoken, the Shoryuken, the Tatsumaki. One will chase the perfect strike; the other will chase his best friend.

Title: The Raging Demon
Body: Gouken's brother Gouki embraces the Satsui no Hado - the Dark Hado, a power fuelled by the will to kill. He turns it on their own master, Goutetsu, with the forbidden Shun Goku Satsu. Gouki becomes Akuma, and the shadow of the Dark Hado will follow Ryu for the rest of his life.

Title: The Scar
Body: At the first World Warrior tournament Ryu reaches the Muay Thai emperor Sagat. Battered and losing, Ryu lets a flicker of the Dark Hado guide one desperate Shoryuken that tears across Sagat's chest. Ryu wins the tournament - and Sagat is left with a scar and an obsession.

Title: Psycho Power
Body: In the shadows a man casts away his own conscience to master Psycho Power. As M. Bison he builds Shadaloo - a crime empire of drugs, arms and brainwashed soldiers - and sets out to conquer the world. Every great fighter's power is just one more battery to him.

Title: The World Warrior
Body: Bison sponsors a second World Warrior tournament. The prize money draws the world's best, but the real target is Ryu: Bison wants a body strong enough to hold his Psycho Power. Guile hunts the man who killed Charlie, Chun-Li hunts the man who killed her father - and all roads lead to Shadaloo.

Title: Seth and S.I.N.
Body: With Shadaloo in pieces, its weapons division S.I.N. and its leader Seth stage a new tournament to harvest data on the Satsui no Hado. Gouken returns from the dead with the Power of Nothingness, and Ryu learns that the darkness inside him can be calmed - not killed.

Title: A Shadow Falls
Body: Bison launches the Black Moons, satellites that amplify Psycho Power over the whole planet. The world's warriors unite. Ryu, at peace at last, purges Bison's power with the Power of Nothingness, and Shadaloo finally falls.

Title: The Third Strike
Body: A secret society led by the god-like Gill hosts a third tournament to find humanity's strongest. A new generation - Alex, Yun, Ibuki - steps in, while Ryu keeps walking his endless road and Akuma tests himself against a would-be deity.

Title: A New Era
Body: Years later, Ken is framed by JP, the smiling head of Nayshall, and goes on the run. A new champion, Luke, rises; Ryu becomes the teacher he once needed. The fight is passed on to everyone who picks up a stick - the Way of the Hado continues.
